## The claim

The drug evidence ladder is independent of step 8's second instrument: revising the mechanism card to version 5 with the k-mer dosage route changes no rung, no shortlist row and no do-not row; F8 acts only on how the report argues direction D2 and on what the card can say about X, Y and the detection floor.

**Prediction if true.** A re-grade on card v5 returns evidence_ladder.tsv, shortlist.tsv and do_not.tsv with unchanged sha256 (47d1e415, 77b6b352, a7b09e9f), while every Track 2 provenance manifest names card version 5.

**What would refute it.** Any row of evidence_ladder.tsv, shortlist.tsv or do_not.tsv differing between the card-v4 and card-v5 runs.
